comment.body:
Thanks for the exact 0.62.0-to-0.62.1 regression steps.

Please retest the same two remaps on the current stable PowerToys release and provide the following.
1. The current PowerToys version.
2. Your Windows keyboard layout, physical keys used, and any other remapping software.
3. A `/bugreport` comment immediately after Left Alt + C, then X fails while Alt remains held.

This will show whether the current Keyboard Manager modifier state is still responsible.
